      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled P2P and replaces the core network stack's private broadcast implementation, completely removing bespoke bypasses in CConnman and PeerManager.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Decoupling private broadcast into isolated threads eliminates pervasive special-case bypasses in core networking and prevents transaction linkage leaks. As described, 'The previous private broadcast implementation was intertwined with the node's main connection manager and peer logic, adding pervasive special-case exceptions' and risking 'privacy linkage through node mempool interaction, timing, or adversarial peer manipulation'. Retiring these message-handling hazards provides substantial, durable architectural and privacy value within P2P."
